audience: Greek small businesses that run clients, invoices and products in CBO

useCases.title: Find unpaid sales invoices
useCases.text: List the sales invoices with status, date and client filters. Open one to see its lines and totals.

useCases.title: Review open sales orders and offers
useCases.text: List the sales orders and offers for a client or date range. Open one to see its items.

useCases.title: Check supplier invoices and payments
useCases.text: List the supplier invoices by status, date or supplier. Compare them with the payments made to suppliers in the same period.

useCases.title: Add a new client
useCases.text: Create a client record for a person or a company. Creating a record is not idempotent: a repeated call adds another client.

useCases.title: Update a product
useCases.text: Change selected fields of one parent product. The other fields stay as they are.
